title: Figure 17 MOPA laser schematic and Figure 18 N2/CO2/H2 laser gas flow system
description: Two technical schematics. Figure 17, "Schematic of MOPA," shows a master oscillator and power amplifier with electron guns, acoustic mufflers, end mirrors M1/M2, turning flat M3, optical isolator, output scraper and beam expansion optics, with a labelled key. Figure 18, "Schematic of the Laser N2/CO2/H2 Gas Flow System," traces gas from a primary storage tank through a flow control valve, screen, sonic orifice and plenum chamber to the gain cell and gas exit horn, with listed gas pressures (P1 = 150 Atm) and mixture parameters (N2:CO2:H2 3:1:0.08).
